title: illecebrum niveum
intro: Illecebrum niveum, commonly known as Snowdonia rose or White Billy-goat, is a flowering plant species native to Europe. It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Illecebrum niveum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
